_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/costs/test_sacrificed_source_lki.py. Never part of a deck list. t_zack_outlet is Zack Fair's activated ability on a vanilla 1/1: sacrificed as its cost, it puts its counters on the target and attaches an Equipment that was attached to it. t_zack_gear and t_zack_gear_two are vanilla Equipment; t_zack_charm is a vanilla Aura, attached to Zack so the Equipment filter can be seen to bite.
